title: I-DARE representation-learning feasibility gate

summary_decision.interpretation: Arousal has a confirmed high-disagreement EEG-bandpower residual signal, but direct correction/bridge/rescue/sample-reduction failed. The next route should learn a representation that can preserve the signal while correcting scale and direction.
Fixed features failed the actionable gates. The next route should test learned EEG/EMG representations rather than more linear correction on engineered features.

route_matrix.why: Zero-shot, after-fewshot, locked-baseline bridge, failure-subject rescue, and sample-reduction gates did not pass.
route_matrix.keep: Use as historical baseline and sanity-check only.

route_matrix.why: Arousal high-disagreement EEG-bandpower passed confirmatory residual gates, but failed bridge/rescue/sample-reduction actionability.
route_matrix.keep: Use for gating, uncertainty, curriculum, or targeted representation learning.

route_matrix.why: The fixed-feature bottleneck is now the most plausible blocker after repeated no-go actionability audits.
DEAP has limited per-subject calibration data, so representation learning may need pretraining or external affective physiology data.
route_matrix.keep: Pretrain on available EEG/EMG datasets, then evaluate under locked I-DARE gates.

success_gates.required_for_claim: Any new EEG/EMG model must beat or complement B2_LOCKED kernel_residual_shrink4 k=16, not merely stimulus-only.
success_gates.metric: pooled RMSE lift >= 0.02 plus paired subject CI/sign tests and stable win margin

success_gates.required_for_claim: If claiming targeted residual learning, evaluate high-disagreement residuals separately.
success_gates.metric: positive residual RMSE lift, residual Pearson > 0.1, permutation p < 0.05, paired subject support

success_gates.required_for_claim: If claiming practical calibration savings, lower-k model must match locked k=16.
success_gates.metric: candidate RMSE within +0.02 of B2 plus subject-level stability

success_gates.required_for_claim: Gating or targeted corrections must not improve one subset by harming pooled performance.
success_gates.metric: pooled and paired subject metrics remain non-inferior to B2

experiment_backlog.title: Arousal high-disagreement EEG representation prototype
experiment_backlog.input_representation: EEG time-frequency tensors or raw/preprocessed EEG segments
experiment_backlog.model_family: small CNN/TCN/Transformer encoder with residual head
experiment_backlog.success_condition: beats fixed EEG-bandpower residual model on high-disagreement arousal and does not degrade locked personalization when used as gate/correction

experiment_backlog.title: Subject-adaptive residual representation
experiment_backlog.input_representation: EEG/EMG learned embeddings plus k-shot subject context
experiment_backlog.target: rating minus stimulus mean / residual correction
experiment_backlog.success_condition: beats B2 locked baseline or matches B2 with fewer calibration samples

experiment_backlog.title: Self-supervised physiology pretraining
experiment_backlog.model_family: masked reconstruction, contrastive predictive coding, subject-invariant contrastive learning
experiment_backlog.target: pretrained representation for downstream residual/deviation prediction
experiment_backlog.success_condition: pretrained representation beats fixed-feature models under locked ROCA gates

experiment_backlog.title: Arousal high-disagreement uncertainty/gating model
experiment_backlog.input_representation: confirmed EEG-bandpower signal plus locked model uncertainty/error features
experiment_backlog.target: detect trials where locked personalization is likely wrong
experiment_backlog.success_condition: improves high-disagreement arousal triage without worsening pooled RMSE

interpretation: Fixed engineered EEG/EMG features have not produced actionable residual learning under locked personalization gates. The next scientifically justified route is learned physiology representation, with arousal high-disagreement EEG signal preserved as a targeted entry point.
